paper_metadata.title: Effect of Ga on the microstructure and properties of NiCoV alloy at different annealing temperatures
paper_metadata.journal: Progress in Natural Science: Materials International

evidence.quote: (NiCoV) 100-xGax (x ¼ 0, 5, 7) was successfully prepared, cold-rolled, and heat-treated.
The (NiCoV) 100-XGax series medium/high entropy alloy has a stable face-centered cubic crystal structure
the alloy still retains a single face-centered cubic structure after 80 % cold rolling and subsequent annealing and water cooling

The tensile fracture form is always the ductile fracture with many dimples.
The addition of Ga can produce alloying effects, including solid solution strengthening effect, second phase precipitation strengthening effect, and layer misalignment energy reduction effect.
The alloy is strengthened mainly by precipitation, and the formation of the precipitation phase effectively enhances the strength of the alloy.
Ga is a low-layer-error-energy metal, and the addition of Ga lowers the layer-error energy of the alloy.
